name: Frill
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Frill, publish feedback, roadmap, and announcements for one product. The hard boundary is hosted polish, custom domain, integrations, widgets, and simple pricing, plus participant network, synthesis workflow, and collaboration.
